usedFor: LiveChat holds your customer conversations and Razorpay takes payment, so “Finished Chat” can run “Create Payment Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: When a chat ends, the customer can be sent a payment link for what was agreed.

watchOut: “Create Payment Link” needs an amount you set or map, because “Finished Chat” does not price anything.
